definitions.explanation: A flexible ruler that can be rolled up, used for measuring lengths.

examples.japanese: {巻尺|まきじゃく}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{部屋|へや}→部屋：00507_heya⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{長|なが}さ→長さ：05326_nagasa⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{測|はか}った→測る：01977_hakaru⟧。
examples.english: I measured the length of the room with a tape measure.

examples.japanese: ⟦{引越|ひっこ}し→引越し：03704_hikkoshi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{時|とき}→時：02918_toki⟧、{巻尺|まきじゃく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。

examples.japanese: {巻尺|まきじゃく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{伸|の}ばして→伸ばす：01973_nobasu⟧⟦{家具|かぐ}→家具：12314_kagu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦サイズ→サイズ：01363_saizu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}→確認：00158_kakunin⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I extend the tape measure to check the size of the furniture.

notes:
{巻尺|まきじゃく} is a tape measure — a flexible measuring tape that winds into a case. Formation: ⟦{巻|ま}き→巻く：02418_maku⟧ 'winding' + ⟦{尺|しゃく}→尺：26043_shaku⟧, the old unit of length that came to mean 'measure' generally.

In everyday speech ⟦メジャー→メジャー：11595_mejaa⟧ (from English 'measure') is at least as common as {巻尺|まきじゃく}, which sounds slightly technical or written.

Two kinds, used by different trades:
- ⟦{裁縫|さいほう}→裁縫：04163_saihou⟧⟦{用|よう}→用：noentry⟧: the soft cloth or vinyl tape used in sewing and for body measurements
- ⟦{工事|こうじ}→工事：00244_kouji⟧⟦{用|よう}→用：noentry⟧: the stiff steel tape that locks and springs back, used on building sites

Collocations:
- {巻尺|まきじゃく}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{測|はか}る→測る：01977_hakaru⟧: to measure with a tape measure
- {巻尺|まきじゃく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{伸|の}ばす→伸ばす：01973_nobasu⟧: to extend the tape
- {巻尺|まきじゃく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{巻|ま}き{戻|もど}す→巻き戻す：15915_makimodosu⟧: to retract it
